stops.note: the native name for dried mugwort burned on the skin in traditional medicine
stops.meaning: dried mugwort used for burning treatments

stops.note: shortened and carried into European medical writing by a Dutch minister describing the remedy from Japan
stops.meaning: combustible dried herb used for therapeutic burning

stops.note: adopted into English medical vocabulary soon after the Dutch account appeared
stops.meaning: a dried herb burned on or near the skin in traditional therapy

current_meaning: dried mugwort burned on or near the skin in the traditional therapy called moxibustion
